title: Federated Recommendation System Launch Reality Check

items.evidence: Strict per-user chronological Leave-Last-2-Out split verified with 0 future-to-past temporal leaks.
99 negative items per user sampled strictly from unobserved set, excluding validation and test ground truth.
Client user embeddings stored exclusively on-device; 0 user embedding bytes transmitted across federation network.
Personalized FL reduces inter-client Gini coefficient to 0.108 and delivers +164.7% lift to smallest client (Client 1).
Personalized FL achieves 0.0860 NDCG@10, retaining 99.8% of Centralized MF-BPR performance (0.0862).
Each round transmits only 184 KB per client (1.8 MB total round footprint), fully viable for edge devices.
Tail items achieve positive recall through shared federated collaborative item embeddings.
